posts.body_html: This year, the mother plant was repotted, but all the winter phyllodia was kept on. It colored up! Photos taken 5/23/19:

posts.body_html:
Even if this clone didn't have that solid red throat (which hasn't quite filled in at the moment), it's still pretty spectacular for that yellow top and red body! Interestingly, the body wasn't all that red when the trap was emerging this spring, but once it opened it, it started getting pretty red. Maybe it'll fill in a bit more later on, who knows.

Pics taken 4/27/20:


Not quite there yet:






Flavas are just starting to crack here in Northern California. Everyone except Almightydolla: are you starting to get flava FEVER yet?

posts.body_html:
minus the really dark to almost black clones, this has to be one of the most unique rubricorporas from Liberty Co, FL. A little more than a week later, this clone has colored up, for the most part, all the way. Pics taken 5/5/20:


I'm starting to appreciate the yellow top on this clone, even if it didn't have that solid red throat, it's still quality genetics:
